protocol.precision: Reuse _configure_ease_precision: FP32 parameters, no autocast, CUDA matmul TF32 off, cuDNN TF32 on, deterministic=True, benchmark=False.
protocol.algorithm_hyperparameters: Retain existing manifest learning rates and method-specific settings; L2P/DualPrompt batchwise_prompt=0. Record effective args including each method's native learning-rate scaling.

accuracy_policy.scope: Accuracy must be strictly greater than 20% as an abnormal-collapse guard for a ten-class, one-epoch pilot; predictions must match reported accuracy. This is not paper reproduction and does not apply EASE's twenty-epoch 1.5/3.0pp margins.

protocol.measurement_policy: Each method runs measurement, measurement, measurement+separate FLOPs in order. Only the three measurement passes enter median/min/max efficiency statistics. EASE is reused without a new experiment.

flops.scope: Partial supported PyTorch operator estimate over initialization, train forward/backward, task-end prototypes, evaluation and diagnostic audits in this separate pass.
flops.limitations: Unsupported/fused operators, optimizer and linear algebra may be omitted; phase FLOPs are not attributed. Not training-only FLOPs. No backward x3 extrapolation.

efficiency.phase_budget: HiDe: TII1+prompt1, two full statistics passes, inferred routing, task1 alignment N/A. Historical methods: one outer epoch and their native task hooks.
efficiency.std_definition: Sample standard deviation (ddof=1) across three executions with the same seed; not uncertainty across seeds.

measurement_scope.energy: Trapezoidal integration of sampled selected physical GPU-board power; excludes CPU/RAM/whole-machine energy and includes idle/other-user board activity.
measurement_scope.time: Recorder process and inclusive synchronized phase times. Final W&B artifact upload/finish is outside Recorder sampling.
measurement_scope.memory: CUDA allocator peak and sampled sum of process-tree RSS; shared RSS pages can be counted multiple times.
measurement_scope.flops: One separate partial supported-operator diagnostic per method; unsupported/fused operators and CPU clustering may be omitted. Diagnostic resource costs are excluded.
measurement_scope.comparison: Historical observations were measured at different times and source snapshots. Matching inputs and settings does not establish equal phase budgets or eliminate measurement drift.
measurement_scope.accuracy: Two-task matched-author correctness and first-task short-pilot accuracy are separate; a first-task pilot cannot establish forgetting or full-sequence CL performance.
